title: Tour and Tasting at Striped Pig Distillery
includes: Additional beverages are available for purchase after your tasting (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
You must be 21+ to participate in the tasting.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: As the first distillery in Charleston, Striped Pig Distillery is a unique experience! We're also one of the few woman owned distilleries, and are family run! Stop in and feel like a part of our family.
